svg.text: Staging/Production Kubernetes Architecture - Air-Gapped Data Center
Scheduler-Managed Workload Distribution with High Availability
Air-Gapped Data Center - No Internet Connectivity

g.text: GitOps Sync • Admin Access • External Load Balancer
Pod-to-Pod Communication • Calico IPIP Overlay • Unrestricted Between All Nodes
Worker Node Pool - Unified Resource Pool (Cattle, Not Pets)
Kubernetes Scheduler Manages All Workload Placement
• Resource Requirements: CPU, Memory, Storage requests
• Pod Anti-Affinity: ACE replicas on different nodes
• Node Selectors: GPU workloads to GPU nodes
• Priority Classes: Critical pods get preference
• Topology Spread: Even distribution across zones
• Node Failure Recovery: Pods auto-reschedule to healthy nodes
• Storage Resilience: Longhorn 3x replication across all workers
• Ingress HA: NGINX on all nodes via DaemonSet
• Control Plane HA: 3-node etcd quorum with kube-vip
• Zero Downtime: Rolling updates and blue-green deployments
• Auto-scaling: HPA/VPA for dynamic resource allocation
